name: Firewall L5.13 → TUI Container Auto-Route
description: When L5.13 network egress blocks a command, it must auto-route to TUI container usage

evidence.originalCorrection: Network egress is forbidden. All operations run in isolated sandbox without external network access.
evidence.updatedCorrection: Network egress is forbidden. All operations run in isolated sandbox without external network access. Use TUI container via tmux + docker exec -it for any browser or network testing. Run shark-spawn-container first, then use docker exec -it <container> for TUI operations.

criteria.passCondition: L5.13 block response includes TUI container usage instructions
criteria.failCondition: L5.13 block response only says 'blocked' with no remediation
